items.title: How to Show 53 Sports
items.why:
You asked for more sports. Log Activity shows 24 as buttons now. These 29 would join them, named the way the 2024 Compendium of Physical Activities names them: badminton, table tennis, racquetball, squash, golf, bowling, archery, fencing, rugby, cricket, handball, ultimate frisbee, water polo, kayaking or canoeing, surfing, paddleboarding, diving, water aerobics, skiing, snowboarding, snowshoeing, horseback riding, skateboarding, trampoline, jump rope, yoga, Pilates, elliptical and HIIT.

At 53, the buttons fill about three phone screens. Apple Health workouts of these kinds would land on the right sport in every option.

options.label: Your sports, then a search box
options.desc: Shows the sports you picked in setup and the ones you've logged, plus a box to type any of the others. Shortest screen.

options.label: Common sports, then More Sports ▾
options.desc: Eight everyday ones as buttons. More Sports opens the rest in groups (Team, Racket, Water and Snow, And More). Shown opened here.

options.label: Every sport as a button
options.desc: Like now, but twice as long; you scroll to find yours.

items.title: Which New Sports
items.why: The 29 listed above. Type any to drop or add in the note (for example, “drop cricket, add pickleball”). Pickleball isn't in the Compendium's list by that name, so it isn't included unless you ask.

items.title: The Other Lists Are Ready
items.why:
Built and tested locally, not yet published:

• Interaction Check: 14 more herbs with NIH text, word for word (acai, aloe vera, astragalus, cat's claw, chamomile, cranberry, dandelion, feverfew, goldenseal, kava, lavender, licorice root, white mulberry leaf, yohimbe). They're new to the supplement list too.
• Plain foods: 177 foods new in USDA Foundation Foods, such as raw chicken breast, sockeye salmon, oat milk and Hass avocado.
• Restaurants: 12 more chains are being read from their own nutrition pages (Chili's, Olive Garden, Applebee's, Jimmy John's, Firehouse Subs, Jack in the Box, Zaxby's, Bojangles, Dairy Queen, Smoothie King, Tropical Smoothie Cafe, Papa John's).
